justification: The only meaningful overlap is that both surfaces include simplified figurative forms with body parts indicated by linear carving/relief. A is dominated by a frontal anthropomorphic figure with facial features, torso details, paired circular forms and bands, whereas B shows a sparse profile quadruped-like animal on a plain surface, with no comparable human body scheme or internal symbolic arrangement.
